# openmetadata_data_asset (Resource)

Manages the metadata of a data asset that already exists in OpenMetadata, such as a table or topic created by an ingestion pipeline. The resource never creates the asset: it looks it up by `type` and `fully_qualified_name` (failing if it does not exist), then applies the attributes you set with a JSON Patch. Attributes you leave out are not managed and keep their current value. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state; the asset itself is left untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The asset must already exist, e.g. created by an ingestion pipeline that
# ran against the "warehouse" database service. Terraform only manages the
# attributes set below; everything else keeps its ingested value.
resource "openmetadata_data_asset" "orders" {
  type                 = "table"
  fully_qualified_name = "warehouse.analytics.public.orders"

  display_name = "Orders"
  description  = "One row per customer order, refreshed hourly."

  owners = [
    {
      id   = openmetadata_team.data_engineering.id
      type = "team"
    }
  ]

  domains        = [openmetadata_domain.analytics.name]
  tags           = ["PII.Sensitive"]
  glossary_terms = ["Finance.Revenue"]

  # Custom property values; the object replaces all existing values.
  extension_json = jsonencode({
    dataRetentionDays = 365
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the existing asset, e.g. `my_service.my_db.public.orders` for a table.
- `type` (String) Type of the data asset: one of `api_collection`, `api_endpoint`, `chart`, `container`, `dashboard`, `dashboard_data_model`, `database`, `database_schema`, `ml_model`, `pipeline`, `search_index`, `stored_procedure`, `table`, `topic`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the resource.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of the domains the asset belongs to. Set to `[]` to remove all domains; omit to leave them untouched.
- `extension_json` (String) Custom property values of the asset as a JSON object (use `jsonencode`). The object replaces all existing custom property values, so list every property you want to keep. Values are compared in the format OpenMetadata returns them. Omit to leave custom properties untouched.
- `glossary_terms` (List of String) Fully qualified names of glossary terms (e.g. `Finance.Revenue`) applied manually to the asset. Set to `[]` to remove all manual glossary terms; omit to leave them untouched.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of the asset. Set to `[]` to remove all owners; omit to leave the current owners untouched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `tags` (List of String) Fully qualified names of classification tags (e.g. `PII.Sensitive`) applied manually to the asset. Tags applied by auto classification or derived from glossary terms are preserved and not listed here. Set to `[]` to remove all manual tags; omit to leave them untouched.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the resource assigned by OpenMetadata.
- `name` (String) Name of the asset (last segment of the fully qualified name).

### Nested Schema for `owners`

Required:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner entity (user or team).
